svg.aria-label: RTFNet18V2 architecture: two ResNet-18 encoders with additive fusion into the RGB stream, a five-stage decoder and a 1x1 classifier
svg.title: RTFNet18V2 architecture
svg.text: THERMAL ENCODER · ResNet-18 with a 1-channel stem
⊕ = element-wise addition into the RGB stream after the stem and after layer1–layer4 (five fusion points).
The thermal stream is never modified by the fusion. Output: raw logits (no softmax), trained with cross-entropy.
Default head: plain 1×1 convolution (head="conv1x1"). head="official" ends the decoder in BatchNorm + residual scores.
